g.text: L1 — upeg host start --daemon — persistent, strong intent
L2 — Desktop GUI + Tray — local HTTP host enabled (default off)
L3 — upeg host start (foreground) — explicit intent, may be short
L4 — upeg call / upeg mcp / upeg tui — not host-eligible
